profile.summary: The Oakland Fund for Children and Youth (OFCY) is a City of Oakland program that gives grants to community-based organizations serving Oakland children and youth from birth to age 21. It has funded programs in areas such as education, career readiness, health and community engagement since 1996. It is paid for through the Kids First! Oakland Children's Fund and is run by the Human Services Department.
